article.title: American Jews’ continued support for Israel is very bad for Jews. We must wake up.
article.author: Philip Weiss
article.content: The Israel lobby is losing its grip on U.S. electoral politics, but it won't go out without a fight. American Jews cannot wait to see how it plays out. The Jewish future depends on our awakening.
